name: pvsyst-mcp
description: Automates PVsyst 8.1.7 through its data files and the documented PVsystCLI commands.
long_description:
Unofficial MCP server for **PVsyst 8.1.7**: projects, variants, components, sites and weather, simulation and results, operated through PVsyst's own data files and the documented `PVsystCLI` commands. Every write is snapshotted first and can be restored.

**Requirements:** Windows x64 with PVsyst 8.1.7 installed. Headless simulation needs a PVsystCLI licence; without it the CLI runs in TRIAL mode.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by PVsyst SA. No PVsyst code is included or decompiled.

tools.name: entorno
tools.description: Entorno PVsyst: diagnostico, licencia, logs y preferencias. / EN: PVsyst environment: diagnostics, licence, logs and preferences.

tools.name: disenar_sistema
tools.description: E2E en una llamada: coordenadas + kWp (red o aislado) -> sitio -> proyecto -> dimensionado -> simulacion -> KPIs. / EN: End-to-end in one call: coordinates + kWp (grid or stand-alone) -> site -> project -> sizing -> simulation -> KPIs.

tools.name: listar
tools.description: Lista proyectos, componentes, modulos, archivos u objetos. / EN: Lists projects, components, modules, files or objects.

tools.name: leer
tools.description: Lee cualquier archivo PVsyst: proyecto, modulo, sitio, meteo, componente, objeto o bytes crudos (detectado por archivo). / EN: Reads any PVsyst file: project, module, site, weather, component, object or raw bytes (detected from the file).

tools.name: editar
tools.description: Edita campos, inserta o elimina objetos PVObject (byte-preserving, con historial). / EN: Edits fields, inserts or removes PVObject objects (byte-preserving, with history).

tools.name: escribir_archivo
tools.description: Escribe un archivo dentro del workspace (con historial). / EN: Writes a file inside the workspace (with history).

tools.name: proyecto
tools.description: Ciclo de vida de proyectos y variantes: crear, eliminar, renombrar, dimensionar, diagnosticar, anadir objetos, convertir a seguidor, limite de inyeccion, almacenamiento, perdidas, bombeo, economia, P50/P90 y limpieza de temporales. / EN: Project and variant lifecycle: create, delete, rename, size, diagnose, add objects, convert to tracker, injection limit, storage, losses, pumping, economics, P50/P90 and temp cleanup.

tools.name: componente
tools.description: Base de datos de componentes: crear, borrar, importar, exportar o crear desde ficha tecnica (PVsyst ajusta el modelo en su ventana). / EN: Component database: create, delete, import, export or create from a datasheet (PVsyst fits the model in its own window).

tools.name: sitio
tools.description: Sitios y meteo: crear (coordenadas o CSV), convertir, geometria solar, horizonte y TMY de PVGIS. / EN: Sites and weather: create (coordinates or CSV), convert, solar geometry, PVGIS horizon and TMY.

tools.name: simular
tools.description: Simulacion: ejecutar (con filas/parametros opcionales), preparar entrada, estado, preestimar y barrido. / EN: Simulation: run (optional rows/parameters), prepare input, status, pre-estimate and sweep.

tools.name: resultados
tools.description: Resultados: KPIs, CSV, perdidas, mensual, comparacion, medido_vs_simulado, P50/P90, carbono, economia y entregable. / EN: Results: KPIs, CSV, losses, monthly, comparison, measured vs simulated, P50/P90, carbon, economics and deliverable.

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: Workspace: crear, exportar, importar, exportar proyecto, historial de cambios y restaurar. / EN: Workspace: create, export, import, export project, change history and restore.

tools.name: pvsyst_cli
tools.description: Passthrough a cualquier comando de PVsystCLI. / EN: Passthrough to any PVsystCLI command.

tools.name: gui_observar
tools.description: Observa la GUI de PVsyst: ventanas, controles, texto, captura PNG, formularios por OCR, menus y arbol UIA. / EN: Observes the PVsyst GUI: windows, controls, text, PNG capture, OCR forms, menus and UIA tree.

tools.name: gui_actuar
tools.description: Actua sobre la GUI de PVsyst: clic (tambien por texto visible), escribir, seleccionar, pestana, teclas, menus por posicion, cerrar, lanzar, reiniciar y esperas. / EN: Acts on the PVsyst GUI: click (also by on-screen text), type, select, tab page, keys, menus by position, close, launch, restart and waits.

workspace.title: PVsyst workspace
workspace.description: PVsyst user data folder: the one containing Projects, ComposPV and Meteo. Leave empty to auto-detect it (%USERPROFILE%\PVsyst8.1_Data, Documents\PVsyst8.1_Data or Documents\PVsyst8.1).

pvsyst_cli.title: PVsystCLI.exe
pvsyst_cli.description: Path to the PVsyst headless command-line executable. Leave empty to auto-detect it.

pvsyst_gui.title: PVsyst.exe
pvsyst_gui.description: Path to the PVsyst GUI executable (also locates the read-only DataRO folder). Leave empty to auto-detect it.

aproximaciones.title: MCP approximations
aproximaciones.description: Also enable the MCP's own approximations of PVsyst calculations (pre-estimate, orientation sweep, solar geometry, P50/P90, sizing from kWp, ...). Off: every figure comes from PVsyst. Approximated results are labelled origen: aproximacion_mcp.

escritorio.title: Desktop for the PVsyst GUI
escritorio.description: compartido (default): the GUI tools drive PVsyst on your desktop. aislado: they run PVsyst on a private hidden desktop so the agent never takes your focus, cursor or keyboard (PVsyst warns when you already have it open; Ctrl/Shift shortcuts are not available there).
